cases.exposure_context_quote: A 14-year-old boy presented to the hospital after deliberate ingestion of 50 mL of imidacloprid mixed with alcohol.
cases.agent_quote: History regarding the poison was taken and confirmed with the bottle that the attendees brought to the hospital, Confidor, imidacloprid 17.8% SL.
cases.circumstance: Deliberate ingestion of 50 mL of imidacloprid mixed with alcohol.

symptoms.finding: unconscious state at discovery; drowsy but arousable, dyspnoeic, profusely sweating on arrival
symptoms.quote: The patient was discovered by his attendees in an unconscious state approximately 30 minutes after the alleged intake. Upon arrival at the hospital, the patient was drowsy but arousable, dyspnoeic, and profusely sweating.

symptoms.finding: GCS 8/15, SpO2 78% at room air, bilateral crepitations
symptoms.quote: On examination, the patient was drowsy, with a Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) score of 8/15 E2V2M4, saturation of 78% at room air, respiratory rate of 30 breaths per minute, blood pressure of 120/80mmHg, and pulse rate of 60 beats per minute.
This saturation gap along with the dark color of his blood raised suspicion of methemoglobinemia. It was confirmed by meth-hemoglobin (met-Hb) on ABG which of 8% and met-Hb by spectrometry of 8.2%.

cases.time_to_care: Discovered unconscious approximately 30 minutes after intake; exact time to hospital arrival UNVERIFIED

labs.name: serum sodium
labs.quote: An examination of serum electrolytes showed the following: sodium 145 mEq/L, potassium 3.6 mEq/L, and chloride 103 mEq/L.

labs.quote: It was confirmed by meth-hemoglobin (met-Hb) on ABG which of 8% and met-Hb by spectrometry of 8.2%.

treatment.name: intubation and mechanical ventilation
treatment.quote: The patient was intubated and received antibiotics for suspected aspiration following alcohol intoxication.

treatment.name: methylene blue 1 mg/kg bolus
treatment.quote: Methylene blue 1 mg/kg was given as a bolus dose, and repeat ABG after one hour showed met-Hb of 4% and after 12 hours of 0.2%.

treatment.name: high dose vitamin C daily
treatment.quote: A high dose of vitamin C was also administered daily.

cases.icu_admission: UNVERIFIED (intubation and mechanical ventilation documented, ICU admission not explicitly stated)
cases.outcome: survived, discharged after one week of hospital stay
cases.outcome_quote: The patient’s sensorium improved and he was discharged after one week of hospital stay.
cases.notes: Methemoglobinemia from imidacloprid ingestion; met-Hb fell to 4% at 1 h and 0.2% at 12 h after methylene blue.
